title: Multi-Storey Commercial Development & Column Structural Shoring
shortDescription: Precision structural engineering execution featuring reinforced concrete column formwork, heavy-duty adjustable shoring systems, and high-tensile steel rebar cages on an elevated commercial deck.
overview: Active structural engineering and site construction coordination for a modern multi-storey commercial facility. The works showcase precision-engineered timber and steel column shuttering, rigid diagonal shoring systems designed to resist hydrostatic lateral pressures during concrete placement, and dense Grade 460B reinforcement bar assemblies executed in strict conformance with structural design specifications.
objectives: Ensure vertical alignment (plumbness), eliminate differential deflection during concrete placement, guarantee watertight formwork joints to prevent grout leakage, and enforce occupational safety on elevated decks.
scopeOfWork: Structural formwork fabrication and erection, rebar cutting, bending and cage placement, concrete cover spacer block distribution, laser leveling, plumb-line verification, and pre-pour technical sign-offs.
technicalApproach: Utilized engineered modular formwork panels, heavy-duty adjustable steel push-pull props, calibrated steel tie-rods with high-torque wing-nuts, and Grade 460B high-yield deformed bars with controlled cover depth.
projectOutcome: Accurate column alignment across the multi-bay grid, clean concrete finishes upon de-shuttering, and verified structural integrity in compliance with Nigerian National Building Codes.
seoTitle: Multi-Storey Column Structural Shoring | SPES Swiftpace Engineering
metaDescription: Case study of reinforced concrete column shuttering and structural shoring systems by SPES Swiftpace in South-West Nigeria.
